purpose: Define a lossless/explicit handoff from an initial DWH snapshot/query result into subsequent changefeed consumption without gaps or ambiguous double-application.

owns: DWH Snapshot to Stream Handoff semantics

topics.name: DWH Snapshot to Stream Handoff
topics.purpose: Define a lossless/explicit handoff from an initial DWH snapshot/query result into subsequent changefeed consumption without gaps or ambiguous double-application.

semantics.snapshot_rule: Initial state is anchored to an exact snapshot/revision/watermark boundary.
semantics.stream_rule: Changefeed begins from the exact continuation position associated with that boundary.
semantics.gap_rule: No-gap guarantee may be claimed only when source profile proves snapshot/stream continuity.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Overlap, if used for safety, requires explicit deduplication by exact change identity/revision.
semantics.identity_rule: Snapshot identity, subscription identity and stream cursor remain distinct.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown handoff point hard-fails/requires resnapshot rather than guessing.
semantics.lineage_rule: Consumers can trace current state back to snapshot plus subsequent changes.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.

hard_gates.condition: snapshot and stream positions guessed independently
no-gap guarantee claimed without source evidence

references.purpose: Initial state anchors exact snapshot boundary.
Stream continuation uses exact source position.

prose.summary: Define a lossless/explicit handoff from an initial DWH snapshot/query result into subsequent changefeed consumption without gaps or ambiguous double-application.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH mutation/persistence, Event causality, sync and remote-sharing contracts.
